length_weighting_scope.definition: For negative advantage sequences,u_i=min(1,2048/T_i); within each actual global128 update,lambda matches original negative absolute-advantage token mass. Final weight=lambda*u_i can exceed1. Positive/zero advantage weights remain1.

negative_mass_renormalization_cases.population: actual accepted training; two global128 updates (8 ranks x16 responses); negative means A<0, not correctness
limits: The conserved quantity is negative abs(A)*token mass, not parameter gradient or Adam displacement.
Observed float32 scalar weights and selected native statistics were joined to final metadata/CSV; selected raw log line bytes were not rehashed at closure.
No counterfactual update or new model/detector computation; these cases do not establish gradient causality or a universal effect.

measurement_scope: Candidates: all newly completed training rollout groups601..650 including rejected all-correct/all-wrong; q only, no actorp/d/A gradient observations for untrained candidates.
Accepted: actual512 responses per round, partitioned by saved A sign; tokens and statistics include masked and zero-A positions unless explicitly a direct-coefficient field.
Correctness acc and advantage sign are distinct. A is the actual group-relative training advantage; correctness alone does not reconstruct it.
NLL(q)=-logq and logPPL=token-pooled meanNLL. d=abs(logp-logq) is a separate mismatch metric; neither replaces the other.
Direct dL/dlogp coefficient mass/L2 is not a positive/negative parameter-gradient norm or causal gradient decomposition. Whole-parameter norm is measured once per actual optimizer update.
Primary: repeated64-question8-response native evaluations; no fixed per-question/replicate request seeds, and no q/p/d or advantage-sign statistics are claimed here.
Cycle128, strictR exact-or-noisy token masks and garble candidates are different nonexclusive mechanical detectors; absence of one is not a semantic normality verdict.
